title: Global Existence of Classical Solutions to the Relativistic Quantum Hydrodynamic System with Small Initial Data
summary: We establish global existence, decay, and scattering for sufficiently small, smooth, and localized perturbations of a constant non-vacuum equilibrium of a relativistic quantum hydrodynamic system in three space dimensions. In logarithmic-amplitude and phase variables, the equations form a semilinear system of coupled wave equations. The skew-symmetric coupling between the time derivatives cancels in the energy identity, yielding a natural derivative energy. The linearized system has two dispersion branches.
